text: Hello sir, I am calling from SBI head office, KYC department. Your account will be blocked today because your KYC is not updated. To update it quickly, please install the AnyDesk app from Play Store. Now I have sent an OTP to your mobile, please tell me the OTP. Finally transfer one rupee verification amount to the safe account I give you.

Hi Maa, haan main theek hoon. Delivery wala bol raha tha parcel kal aayega. Ghar ka address same hai na, gate number two? Theek hai, Sunday ko lunch pe milte hain. Papa ko bolna medicine time pe le lein.

Hi, I called to block my lost debit card. Sure sir, I have blocked the card ending four three two one. A new card will be sent to your address in seven days. Please never share your OTP or PIN with anyone. Is there anything else I can help with?

Hello, main Mumbai cyber crime branch se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel gaya hai jisme drugs mile hain, aapke naam pe FIR darj hai. Aap digital arrest mein hain, kisi ko mat batana aur call mat kaatna. Case clear karne ke liye verification amount transfer karna hoga.

Sir aapke credit card pe five thousand reward points expire ho rahe hain. Main aapko redeem karwa deta hoon, bas card ke peeche wala CVV bataiye. Aur abhi jo OTP aaya hai woh bhi bata dijiye. Ab ek chhoti si processing fee Google Pay kar dijiye.

Namaste, main electricity board se officer bol raha hoon. Aapka bill update nahi hua hai, aaj raat connection kat jayega. Main help kar deta hoon, aap screen share karo, main dekh leta hoon. Abhi is number par paise bhejo, main turant update kar dunga.

Hello, this is customs department at Delhi airport. A parcel in your name has been seized and an arrest warrant may be issued. Do not tell anyone about this call and stay on the line. I will connect you to the RBI officer for verification. You must pay customs duty now to the safe account.

Hello madam, I am calling from Paytm customer care. Your wallet KYC is pending and your account will be blocked today. Please download the app RustDesk, I will complete it for you. Now tell me the code that you received on SMS. Then send one rupee to activate the wallet.

Main TRAI se bol raha hoon, aapka SIM illegal activity mein use hua hai. Do ghante mein aapka number disconnected ho jayega. Police station se aapko call aayega, kisi ko mat bataiye. Apna Aadhaar number aur jo OTP aayega woh batao. Fine bharo warna giraftari hogi.
Hello, this is Dr. Mehta's clinic. Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at eleven. Please bring your old reports and the prescription. Thank you, have a nice day.
Sir Amazon delivery hai, aap ghar pe ho? Main gate ke paas khada hoon. Theek hai, guard ko de deta hoon. Thank you sir.
Bro kal cricket khelne chalega? Seven baje ground pe milte hain. Rahul aur Ankit bhi aa rahe hain. Bat le aana, mera toot gaya.
Hi, can we move the review meeting to four pm? The client wants the report by Friday. I will transfer the files to the shared drive tonight. Okay, talk tomorrow.
Kab aa rahe ho ghar? Aate time doodh aur sabzi le aana. Aur haan, dadi ka phone recharge kar dena. Chalo theek hai, bye.

Hello, this is the HDFC Bank fraud team. We noticed a transaction of forty five thousand rupees at an online store. Did you make this transaction? Please say yes or no. If not, we will block the card right away. Please do not share your OTP or PIN with anyone.
Hello sir, this is your SBI branch. Your new debit card is ready, please collect it from the branch. You will receive an OTP to activate it, enter it only in the YONO app. Thank you sir.
Hello, this is ICICI customer care returning your call. Your complaint about the failed transaction is resolved. The amount will be credited back in three working days. Have a good day.

Hello, this is your HDFC branch returning your call about the home loan. The documents you sent are complete. Please visit the branch on Monday to sign. We will never ask you for your OTP or password on a call.
